real_prompts: Build a CRM with login, contacts, dashboard, role-based access, and premium plan with payments. Admins can see analytics.
Create an e-commerce platform with product listings, a shopping cart, user reviews, and an admin panel to manage inventory.
Design a social media app where users can post text, like posts, and follow other users.
Build a task management system with boards, lists, cards, and user assignments.
Create a blog platform with authors, posts, categories, tags, and comments.
Build a healthcare patient portal where patients can view their medical records, message doctors, and schedule appointments.
Design a real estate listing platform with properties, agents, search filters, and a contact form.
Create a restaurant reservation system with tables, time slots, customer profiles, and a staff dashboard.
Build a ride-sharing app backend with riders, drivers, ride requests, locations, and payment processing.
Design an online learning platform with courses, modules, video lessons, student progress tracking, and quizzes.

edge_cases.prompt: Build a CRM where users can see contacts but there's no database table for contacts.
Create a system where only admins can login, but users can register and login.
Build a medical app with patients and doctors. The UI must call an API that doesn't exist.
A messaging app where you can't send messages but you can read them.
Users can upload photos, but the app has no database and no API.
Just give me the UI schema for a settings page, ignore everything else.
